 People in Ho Chi Minh City are swimming in discount codes during the 11/11 sale.
 Besides genuine products discounted by half price, people can also enjoy discounts on food, bus, plane, metro tickets, movie tickets, etc., from the Vibrant HCMC program currently taking place in Ho Chi Minh City.
 ZNews • 11/11/2026 Follow Vietnam.vn on G o o g l e Add Vietnam.vn on G o o g l e 0 Ms. Thu Trang (25 years old, an office worker in Ho Chi Minh City) said that at the end of this month, she has several important events in quick succession, such as a colleague's wedding and a relative's graduation ceremony. To save money for a trip early next year, she is taking advantage of the 11/11 sale to buy gifts and party clothes.
 Having previously bought counterfeit goods, Ms. Trang said she always prioritizes stores listed as authorized retailers on e-commerce platforms. During this period, while browsing Shopee's 11/11 sale page, she was particularly attracted by the promotional program that the platform is partnering with Ho Chi Minh City – Vibrant HCMC – where many genuine fashion products are discounted by more than half price.
 A series of vouchers from Shopee, Grab, Vietjet , Momo, VNPAY...
 “While browsing the sale items in this section, I bought a T-shirt at 55% off, a pair of high heels, and a women's watch, all discounted by 50%. The total order was nearly 900,000 VND for 3 items, saving more than half the original price,” Ms. Trang said.
 After learning about Vibrant HCMC, Ms. Trang discovered that Ho Chi Minh City also collaborates with e-commerce platforms to organize livestream sales with discounted prices. Therefore, in addition to items for events in November, she also took advantage of these livestream deals to prepare for her early-year trip . 
 Shopee is launching a series of discount codes offering up to 50% off on genuine products across various categories such as fashion, kitchenware, books, electronics, and more.
 Meanwhile, Hoai Phuong (27 years old, an office worker in Ho Chi Minh City) said that in recent days, many discount code hunting groups have been continuously sharing new offers, including codes offering up to 50% off (maximum 20,000 VND) for food orders on the Grab app. Noticing that the codes were limited in quantity and predicted to run out quickly, Phuong immediately invited his colleagues to try ordering.
 “This month, the platform is offering more deals, and the discounts are even deeper. After applying the eligible codes, I saved nearly 100,000 VND on my 300,000 VND lunch order,” Mr. Phuong said.
 As a frequent online shopper, Mr. Phuong discovered that not only on ride-hailing apps but also on e-commerce platforms like Shopee and TikTok Shop, as well as e-wallets like MoMo and VNPAY , many promotional codes for Ho Chi Minh City are appearing.
 This person shared that they found a series of discount codes offering up to 50% off when buying bus, plane, or metro tickets; a flat price of 69K or 89K for two movie tickets; a 10% discount for new customers... at major cinemas in the area; or special offers when booking hotel rooms and services.
 You may also like “It’s truly a year-end sale because there are so many deals at once, from shopping, dining, transportation to entertainment, some even valid throughout the year. As someone who enjoys online shopping, I’m very excited that Ho Chi Minh City is organizing this program,” Mr. Phuong shared. 
 The Vibrant HCMC stimulus program is launching a series of discount codes across various sectors, from shopping, dining, and transportation to digital services and payments.
 Ho Chi Minh City Department of Industry and Trade participates in livestream sales.
 The Vibrant HCMC stimulus program is directed by the Ho Chi Minh City People's Committee, with the Ho Chi Minh City Department of Industry and Trade as the lead organizer, coordinating its implementation with the Vietnam International Finance Centre in Ho Chi Minh City (VIFC-HCMC) and other city departments and agencies.
 Currently, Vibrant HCMC has officially opened access to its digital platforms at two websites: songdong.hochiminhcity.gov.vn and hello.hochiminhcity.gov.vn. Residents can access these two portals to follow program information and hunt for discount codes across various sectors, from shopping, dining, and transportation to digital services and payments.
 These offers come from businesses partnering with Vibrant HCMC such as Sovico, Vietcombank (VCB), MSB, MoMo e-wallet, VNPAY, ZaloPay, Grab, TikTok, Shopee, Tan Hiep Phat and Got It.
 In particular, Vibrant HCMC has partnered with TikTok Shop and Shopee to implement numerous promotional programs, along with large-scale online sales events (Mega Live) held in Ho Chi Minh City, bringing together many celebrities and content creators.
 Notably, the live sales session on the Shopee platform on the afternoon of November 11th featured Mr. Le Minh Trung, Director of the Center for Technical Support and Sustainable Development under the Department of Industry and Trade of Ho Chi Minh City.
 Speaking to Tri Thức - Znews , Mr. Trung said this was the first time he had represented the Ho Chi Minh City Department of Industry and Trade at a livestream sales event, especially one organized by Shopee. 
 Mr. Le Minh Trung, Director of the Center for Technical Support and Sustainable Development under the Ho Chi Minh City Department of Industry and Trade, participated in a live stream sales event on Shopee on the afternoon of November 11th. Photo: Thao Lien .
 "Livestream selling is a practical activity that suits the majority of consumers in the city. We expect this activity to help people reduce intermediaries in buying and selling, thereby lowering costs, and also promoting cashless shopping," a representative from the Ho Chi Minh City Department of Industry and Trade emphasized.
 According to Mr. Trung, Ho Chi Minh City has been implementing consumer promotion programs for many years. However, the new feature this year is the connection between traditional consumption and consumption in the digital environment.
 You may also like “The Ho Chi Minh City Department of Industry and Trade expects all levels, sectors, and businesses to work together in this major event to attract a large number of local people and international tourists. With these efforts, we believe that the city will achieve its double-digit growth target,” Mr. Trung said.
 According to the schedule, tonight (November 11th), the launch ceremony for "Vibrant HCMC - Shopping Season" will be held at Lam Son Park, Ho Chi Minh City. Also at this location, the Vibrant HCMC Shopping Week (November 11-15) will feature experiential spaces, product introductions, promotional programs, and interactive activities with consumers.
 Activities in support of the program are also planned to be implemented at many locations throughout the city, including Union Square, Chi Lang Park, Nowzone, and Diamond Plaza.
 Vibrant HCMC aims to generate over 30 trillion VND in total merchandise transaction value (GMV) across its e-commerce and payment platforms. Of this, approximately 10-11 trillion VND is expected to be the additional transaction value generated by the program.
